metadata.source: AI Agent Privileged Identity Usage Detection.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: AI Agent Privileged Identity Usage Detection
properties.description:
Detects AI agent runtimes (OpenClaw, Moltbot, ClawDBot, AutoGPT, BabyAGI)
executing under privileged, system, or service accounts.
Focuses on identity misuse and excessive privilege exposure risk
aligned with AI runtime isolation concerns.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("openclaw","moltbot","clawdbot","autogpt","babyagi")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName has_any ("admin","administrator")
    or InitiatingProcessAccountName endswith "$"
    or ProcessIntegrityLevel in ("High","System")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), EventCount=count()
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, ProcessIntegrityLevel, FileName
